title: Howard vs Spelman: tuition, size, location
summary: Howard University (Howard) versus Spelman College (Spelman). Also searched as Spelman vs Howard. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Spelman College and Howard University are both private nonprofit institutions, with Spelman located in Atlanta and Howard in Washington. Spelman has an undergraduate enrollment of 3,414 students, whereas Howard's undergraduate population is significantly larger, totaling 10,108. Tuition costs also differ, with Spelman's in-state tuition at $31,556 compared to Howard's $35,810. These distinctions highlight differences in size, location, and tuition between Spelman vs Howard.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing cost, Spelman College and Howard University have different tuition rates despite both being private nonprofit institutions. Spelman's tuition for both in-state and out-of-state students is $31,556, while Howard's tuition is higher at $35,810 for both categories. Regarding student debt, the median debt for Spelman graduates who complete their degrees is $25,000, slightly above Howard's median debt of $24,500. These figures provide insight into the financial commitments associated with attending each institution, reflecting differences in tuition and typical student debt levels in the Spelman vs Howard comparison.
